paragraphs.text: Cite Lens for dsh: select text in a PDF in the Files tab to quote or ask about it in the current cha
t, and turn the model's [main.pdf p.7 "exact words"] citations into links that open the PDF and high
light the passage; /cite-links makes a chat cite every claim.
# dsh-cite-lens
English | 中文
A DeepSeek Harness plugin for working on papers with the model, in the PDF you already have open.
- **Select text in a PDF and ask about it.** PDFs in the **Files** tab open with selectable text. Se

lect a passage and send it to the chat you are in — quoted, tagged with the file and page.
- **Click
the model's citations.** When the model cites `[main.pdf p.7 "exact words"]`, the citation is a lin

k: clicking it opens the PDF, scrolls to those words, and highlights them with a fading marker.
- **
`/cite-links`** makes a chat back *every* claim about the paper with such a link — handy for reviewi
ng a draft, or checking what the model changed after editing your LaTeX.
**Everything stays on your machine.** The PDF is rendered in your browser with PDF.js; nothing is up
loaded, and the plugin itself never sends a message — it only fills in your message box.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Restart `dsh web`. PDFs you open from the **Files** tab now use Cite Lens. To go back to dsh's built
-in PDF view, remove the plugin.
## What you get
### Select a passage, ask about it
Select text and a toolbar appears over it:
| Button | Puts in your message box |

| **Quote** | the passage, tagged `main.pdf · p.17`, for you to write under |
| **Ask** | the passag

e, with the cursor waiting after `Question:` |
| **Explain** | the passage and a request to explain

it |
| **Check this** | the passage and a request to check its claims against the paper |
Each is added *under* whatever you have already typed, in the chat you are in. Nothing is sent until
*under* whatever you have already typed, in the chat you are in. Nothing is sent until you send it.
Selection behaves like an editor's, not like a raw PDF text layer:

- it does not jump to the whole page when the cursor crosses the gap between lines or the margin;
-

**handles** at both ends grow or shrink the selection, and snap to the nearest text;
- **Shift+click
** extends or shrinks it; **Shift+←/→** moves the end by a character, **Shift+Alt+←/→** by a word.
### Citations that open the PDF
The plugin adds a short note to each chat's system prompt describing the citation format, so the mod
el can point at places like this:
| The model writes | Clicking it |

| `[p.7]` | the PDF you are reading, page 7 |
| `[main.pdf p.7]` | opens `main.pdf` (or switches to

it) at page 7 |
| `[main.pdf "exact words"]` | opens it, finds the words anywhere in the PDF, highli

ghts them |
| `[main.pdf p.7 "exact words"]` | the same, searching page 7 first |
The page is optional on purpose: after the model edits your LaTeX it rarely knows which page a sente
nce lands on, so it quotes the words and Cite Lens finds them. Matching is forgiving — line breaks,
words hyphenated across lines, ligatures, curly quotes and case are all ignored — and works on pages
that have not been drawn yet. If the words are not in the PDF (it has not been rebuilt since the ed
it, say), the link tells you so instead of jumping somewhere wrong.
Paths are relative to the chat's workspace (`[build/main.pdf "…"]`). A PDF that is not open is opene
d through dsh's Files tab. A bare `[p.7]` with nothing open reopens the PDF you used last.
### `/cite-links`
[代码示例省略，未执行]
While it is on, every message you send goes in with a short reminder asking the model to back each s
tatement about the paper with a link — in prose, lists and tables alike. A link icon in the chat's t
op bar shows the state (with a dot when on) and toggles it with a click. The setting is per chat and
survives a restart.
## Requirements
- dsh `0.1.5-rc.2` or newer, **web** profile (`dsh web`). Developed against the 0.1.5 line and check
ed on `0.2.1-rc.3`: the PDF preview registers as an external-band renderer with `binaryExtensions: [

'pdf']`, which is the contract both lines share.
- Node.js 22 or newer
- A current browser. Citation
links are underlined with the CSS Custom Highlight API; in a browser without it they still work whe
n clicked, they just are not underlined. Tested in Chrome.
## How it works
| Piece | dsh seam |
| The PDF view | `ctx.documentPreviews.register({ extensions: ['pdf'], priority: 'extension' })` and

the keyed `sidebar.right.tab.document` slot — the external band ranks above the built-in view |
| W
riting to your message box | the current chat (`ctx.sessions.list`) → its scope (`ctx.sessions.scope
`) → `ctx.conversation.input.for(scope)`: the draft is read and appended to, never replaced, and nev

er touched while a message is sending |
| Opening a cited PDF | `ctx.sidebarRight.openResource(addre

ss)` |
| Citation links | text ranges painted with `::highlight()` and hit-tested on click — the cha

t's DOM is never edited, so streaming replies are unaffected |
| The citation guide | a section in e

ach chat's system prompt (`agent/session-start`) |
| `/cite-links` | a dsh command; while on, a remi
nder joins the step that carries your new prompt (`agent/pre-step`), once per prompt |
Rendering stays smooth on long papers: pages are drawn one at a time nearest to where you are readin
g, first at 1× and then sharp once scrolling stops; far pages are freed; the text layer is built in
t 1× and then sharp once scrolling stops; far pages are freed; the text layer is built in idle time.
## Development
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`lib/client.js` is generated: edit `src/client/` and rebuild. It bundles PDF.js (Apache-2.0) and its
worker, so the plugin needs no static file routes.
## Licence
MIT — see LICENSE, which also carries the notice for the bundled PDF.js.
